The issuer shows only borderline liquidity (current ratio 0.97), fairly high leverage (liabilities are about 74% of assets, with debt-to-equity near 2.9x), and thin operating profitability (EBIT margin about 3.8%). Still, positive EBIT, substantial retained earnings, and a meaningful equity base support a low-end investment-grade assessment rather than speculative grade.

DECISION: BBB-
